# MDN002 `double-precision-literal`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="info" text="opt-in" />

A double precision literal with exponent letter `d` (`1.0d0`).

## Why

`1.0d0` ties the constant to double precision whatever the kind of the expression it appears in;
`1.0_rk` follows the project's kind parameter.

## Reported

```fortran
x = 1.0d-3
```

## Preferred

```fortran
x = 1.0e-3_rk
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[MDN002] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = MDN002` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `MOD002` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
